chunks: And in the narration of Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, that al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام said:
“If a man is among those who becomes forgetful in every three, then he is among those upon whom forgetfulness has become frequent.”

key_terms.ثَلَاثٍ: three; here indicating a recurring measure
key_terms.يَسْهُو: becomes forgetful or inattentive in prayer
key_terms.ٱلسَّهْوُ: forgetfulness or inadvertent lapse in salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: When is a person considered someone with frequent forgetfulness in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a criterion for identifying one who experiences frequent forgetfulness in salat (prayer). It classifies a person who falls into sahw repeatedly at the rate described here as belonging to those for whom forgetfulness is considered excessive, which has implications in the fiqh of prayer.
